# FindableAI

> Machine Discoverability Optimization (MDO) & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform.

FindableAI audits how well AI search engines (SearchGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude) discover, understand, and ground technical claims about web applications. It calculates an evidence-grounded F-Score, flags factual contradictions using Natural Language Inference (NLI), and opens automated pull requests with Schema.org JSON-LD and DOM fixes.

## Canonical F-Score Metric
The discoverability score is computed via the canonical four-pillar formula:
- F = 0.40 * S_ans + 0.30 * S_con + 0.20 * S_str + 0.10 * S_acc (scaled 0-100)
- S_ans (Answerability): Evaluates claim entailment across synthetic personas (Skeptical CTO, Developer Evaluator, Procurement Officer).
- S_con (Consistency): Semantic contradiction detection against authoritative page evidence.
- S_str (Structured Data): Schema.org microdata, JSON-LD graphs, OpenGraph tags, and semantic HTML5 hierarchy.
- S_acc (Accessibility): Crawlability, server headers, bot directives, and rendering performance.

## Core Endpoints & Resources
- [Web Application](https://findableai.vercel.app): Interactive web dashboard and visual inspection suite.
- [Machine Audit Engine](https://findableai.vercel.app/audit): Configure crawl scope (1-25 pages), buyer personas, and GitHub repository.
- [API Documentation](https://findableai.vercel.app/docs): Interactive FastAPI Swagger UI documentation.
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://findableai.vercel.app/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 JSON contract for LLM function calling and agent integration.
- [Full Technical Specification](https://findableai.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive MDO architecture, API schemas, and scoring heuristics.

## Automated PR Engine
When connected with a GitHub repository, FindableAI autonomously generates and tests:
- Framework-native Schema.org JSON-LD components (Next.js, Vite, React).
- AI agent crawl directives (`robots.txt`).
- High-signal `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` files for AI search engine indexing.
